method: Static HTML and inline script inspection; cleave facts and extraction of embedded source; no rendering, script execution or remote resource fetching. All ten roots were confirmed as HTML, including four collector-assigned .hta filenames.

validation.focused_controls: 51 passed: 31 synthetic controls plus ten originals under both original and unrelated filenames
validation.atomscan: Eight benign roots have zero suspicious/hostile findings; both bad roots have three hostile findings spanning two objective directories.
validation.make_validate: Failed on unrelated repository taxonomy leaf placement, platform/meaningless directory naming, unreferenced exception, archive scope and duplicate evidence errors. No reviewed HTML rule appears in the validation errors.

validation.facts_limit: HTML facts do not currently project inline-script ASTs/literals/symbols. The new bounded YARA role compares iframe-constructor and low-opacity receiver names byte for byte; it does not resolve aliases, scopes or reassignment.

rule_changes: Move neutral WordPress REST endpoint references from exploit objectives to HTTP request observations and update consumer.
Move hidden/white/small typography wording from prompt-injection objectives to natural-language vocabulary and update consumers, preserving scope and criticality.

Move neutral Twitter URL, XML parsing, command splitting and filename observations into their capability/path categories. Keep actual dispatch and Meterpreter implementation evidence in C2 objectives.
Move embedded Twitter bot persistence to Startup shortcut objectives; require Startup path, shortcut creation/save and target assignment instead of fixed cache/shortcut names.

Require nearby iframe creation and low DOM-opacity assignment plus pointer positioning for dynamically created self-removing Like traps; visible social widgets and unrelated opacity CSS remain benign.
Clarify unsubscribe/email-footer vocabulary description without changing its match or scope.
